name: How long does a typical house addition project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical house addition project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a house addition project varies significantly based on its size, complexity, and specific requirements, as well as permitting timelines. Generally, a small-to-medium addition might take 3-6 months from design approval to completion, while larger or more complex projects could extend to 8-12 months or more. We provide a detailed timeline estimate after the initial consultation and design phase, factoring in all project stages from planning and permits to construction and finishing touches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by size and complexity, typically 3-6 months for small additions and 8-12 months for larger ones, including design, permits, and construction.
